d: Seven oil tankers have caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz in 48 hours. Iran blames mines. The US says all mines were cleared weeks ago. Iraq's Prime Minister called Donald Trump this week urging him to keep the war off Iraqi soil — the country has lost an estimated $400 billion since the conflict began in February. With the ceasefire fraying and Trump hinting at further action against Iran, Firstpost breaks down what is happening in one of the world's most critical waterways — and who is paying the price. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
